okras: An old straw hat, black, and its rim saggy by virtue of the moisture of sweating sun-fingers, served as a calabash for a ball of "cookoo"--corn meal, okras and butter stewed--roundly poised in its crown.
And with a spatter she flecked the hunk of lard on Jean Baptiste's stewing okras.
Corn, okras, gunga peas, eddoes, tannias, tomatoes--in such a world Ella moved.
